scope: Theorem 4.1 (Generation on the reduced boundary) of the manuscript “Log abundance for compact Kähler spaces under logarithmic Iitaka subadditivity” (preprints/Log-abundance-for-compact-Kahler-spaces-under-logarithmic-Iitaka-subadditivity-October-6-2026/main.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 034 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 46adc5be1070213b), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 79. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Assume Gj for every 0 ≤ j < n. Let (V, B) be a normal irreducible compact Kähler dlt n-fold with effective rational boundary B. Suppose that V is globally Q-factorial, that (V, B) satisfies the lc-strata resolution convention of Definition 3.1, and that the actual Q-Cartier adjoint J = KV + B is analytically nef. Then the restriction of an actual positive Cartier multiple of J to the whole reduced space S = ⌊B⌋ is globally generated.
